question: Under the same available information, cutoff, model snapshot and target, do specialist analyses change forecasts and improve performance enough to justify their cost?
scope: Separate calendar-day contribution study for the legacy engine and production-style agents; does not replace or relabel domestic protocol_v1 trading-session evaluation
execution_disabled_reason: Historical input provenance, held-out case freeze, common adapters and request-based cost estimate are incomplete; this is not an approval request

time.cutoff: 09:00:00 Asia/Seoul, equivalent to 00:00:00 UTC, on each selected Korean trading date
time.base: Last validated Korean trading-session close strictly before the cutoff date
time.endpoint: First validated Korean trading-session close on or after cutoff local date plus horizon calendar days; save nominal target and realized session separately
time.interpretation: Close-to-close direction from prior close, not an executable return from 09:00
time.information_gate: Require recorded availability strictly before cutoff, with verified source timezone, publication precision and historical version eligibility; same-day date-only items are not eligible
time.prices: Trade date is an observation label, not an availability timestamp. Preserve actual row dates, source, adjustment convention, latest allowed close, missing sessions and corporate-action review
time.derived_outcomes: Any event label or future-return-derived feature requires evidence that its entire underlying observation window and computation were available before cutoff; the new computed_at guard alone does not certify provenance
time.macro: Observation period alone is insufficient; use release availability and contemporary vintage
time.same_day_news: Before-cutoff news may be used if independently verified; news after 09:00 must be excluded

cases.candidate_source: Existing domestic stock/date candidates may inform selection only; their trading-session labels are never reused as calendar-day labels
cases.exposure_policy: Legacy report examples and inspected outcomes are development diagnostics only. Record all previously inspected or tuned-on cases before selecting the held-out cohort
cases.chronological_split: Development and setting selection end before the first evaluation cutoff, including the longest forecast endpoint; keep the official market calendar and exposure ledger
cases.replacement_policy: Resolve exclusions before inference with versioned reasons; never replace failures after seeing predictions or gold labels
cases.gold_separation: Store target closes and labels outside generation packets; no future prices, reviewer findings or another condition's output in model inputs

common_information.packet: Immutable target, cutoff, historical price rows, code-computed price features, eligible news/disclosures, economic and technical evidence, source IDs and limitations
common_information.single_multi_identity: Single LLM and every full-information panel receive the same union of source IDs and byte-identical evidence payloads and derived features; save full and per-role packet hashes
common_information.panel_partition: Use the production mapping: news/search, economy, market, semiconductor/technology. Each initial analysis sees only its assigned partition and no peer answer; final integration sees the full common packet and saved analyses
common_information.generic_control: Same four partitions, calls, per-stage token limits and final input as specialist panel, but generic analyst instructions replace specialist role rules
common_information.news_removal: Remove all news-origin evidence and derived summaries from every role and final input, including duplicate copies referenced under another source ID; use origin lineage, not only a news label
common_information.role_removal: Omit the news analyst call, retain its raw evidence in the common final packet. This measures the analyst stage plus its computation; do not call it a pure compute-matched role effect

conditions.rule: Expected return zero; direction NON_UP. Report numerical return error separately
Always UP; do not fabricate a numerical return magnitude
UP if latest allowed close exceeds close 20 sessions earlier, otherwise NON_UP; insufficient history is a recorded failure
Freeze scenario_v2_outcome_cutoff price calculation and set technical/macro contributions to zero; label this an ablation, not the unchanged full engine
Frozen scenario_v2_outcome_cutoff calculation, bound to the same eligible packet; preserve event/technical/macro inputs and no runtime retrieval

conditions.input: four generic independent analyses of the same partitions used by specialist_panel, then common integration
four specialist independent analyses, then common integration
same four roles and final instructions, with news-origin information removed everywhere
three remaining analyst calls and integration; full raw information retained

generation.common_final_schema: For each horizon: UP, NON_UP or explicit abstention; source IDs, observation, hypothesis, countercondition and limitations
generation.comparison_boundary: A controlled adapter using production role and integration logic; equivalence to main.py must be tested before claiming production-system performance
current_missing_adapters: common fixed packet for legacy engine
single/generic/three-role integration using the same final schema
generation.cost_estimation_gate: Compute the exact request estimate and bounded execution limit after eligible inputs and adapters are prepared; no live request from this protocol file alone

evaluation.primary: 7-calendar-day UP/NON_UP generalized MCC over all fixed case IDs; expected or realized zero is NON_UP, never an automatic correct answer
supporting: accuracy with all frozen IDs in denominator
evaluation.invalid: Keep failures and abstentions as INVALID; do not drop them or map them to the observed gold class
evaluation.numerical_metrics: Return MAE only for conditions with defined numerical forecasts (hold and engine variants); mark not applicable for direction-only conditions instead of inventing magnitudes
evaluation.uncertainty: Prespecify paired date-block intervals after the cohort is fixed; keep companies and conditions together; no superiority claim from a few representative examples
evaluation.attribution_log: Per case: each role's hypothesis and cited IDs, final direction and selected basis, changes versus single and each ablation, correctness transitions after unblinding gold
evaluation.cost_time: Record input/output/cached tokens, call count, failed-call reserve and estimated cost; separate API duration sum from measured end-to-end wall time including integration; record concurrency and execution order
evaluation.claim_rule: Positive, null and negative results are valid. News absence is not an established error cause without the paired information ablation; a rationale or retained hypothesis is not evidence of accuracy improvement

gates_before_execution: Exact representative-report and engine versions preserved
No automatic correctness for zero-return forecasts in any scorer
Price, document, event-outcome and macro availability verified for every included input
Original historical source/version uncertainty is resolved or explicitly excluded from eligible evaluation
Temporal split and inspected-outcome exposure ledger frozen
Common packets, price adjustment policy, labels and case set frozen separately
Shared schema, input identity, role isolation and both ablations tested
Exact requests, code hashes, metrics, uncertainty policy and execution limits frozen
